plot-caption: Mean change of c_yes_i from the clean prompt, paired over 100 new images, 95% CI. The bar marks the effect of the text swap on the same images. delete: the name coordinate goes to 0. add: the other name takes the coordinate of the name, and the name stays. swap: both. null: the name against an unrelated noun. rand_match: the swap edit along random vectors, with the same size at each position.
